posts.name: Ayush Shukla
posts.cooked:
I am currently repeating the OPPE for the System Commands course. As per the instructions, it is mentioned that students repeating the OPPE are required to complete the BPTs again in order to become eligible for the OPPE.

However, when I log into my VM, it is only showing the previous term’s BPTs and questions. I am unable to see any updated or current BPTs for this term. Because of this, I am unsure how to proceed and complete the required tasks for eligibility.

Kindly guide me on what I should do next or let me know if there is any issue from my side that needs to be resolved.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
As mentioned in this thread by Swati, if you’re just repeating the OPPE you can just submit the BPTs that are already present on your VM. Additionally, if you do wish to, you can just delete your old BPTs and reattempt them.

Repeat OPPE for system commands System Commands
There is no new id. You have only one user account. If your BPTs are already there, you can just submit them when they are available before the deadline.

22f3000458:

I could not login into power shell

Do ls .ssh in your C-drive C:\Users\vinot and look for a file named id_rsa.pub. If you see one then do cat id_rsa.pub and paste the contents in it at the vm website to reupload your public key.

If the file is not there then recreate it using ssh-keygen and upload it on the same website again.

22f3000458:

i am only repeating oppe so whether i have to do bpt

You can either submit the BPTs in your VM or choose to delete them and solve from scratch again (latter is recommended).

posts.name: Kaashifa Ahmed
posts.cooked:
Hello,

I have registered for the Repeat OPPE in the System Command course this term. As instructed, I regenerated my SSH key and logged into the course VM to resubmit the BPTs in order to be eligible for the OPPE.

However, I noticed that the VM appears to be the same as in the previous term. All my previously submitted script folders are still present, and the questions also seem to be the same as last term’s.

I would like to clarify whether my existing scripts will be evaluated for this term, or if I am required to redo and resubmit them.

Kindly please confirm.

Thank you.

@Mrinal.exe

posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked: yes your existing scripts will be evaluated for this term, you are just required to resubmit them using synchro eval (i guess that is the command to submit)

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Can you please include the steps you’ve taken? We can only help you if you provide us the relevant information about the problems you’re facing and what all you’ve tried for fixing the issues.
